title: Hold a security business licence
what: Hold the state's security business (or agent) licence before providing security services, and use only licensed staff.

sources.title: Private Security Act 1995 (NT)
sources.quote: A person shall not: (a) carry out the functions of a security provider; or (b) advertise, or in any way hold out, that the person carries out or is willing to carry out, the functions of a security provider, unless the person holds the appropriate licence.
